name: Tethered Arrow
description:
Once per day per rank you have in Craft: The next time you fire a projectile weapon this turn, halve the range of the weapon for the shot, and the projectile carries with it a thin cord, which stretches from the where it lands to you, up to far range.

The cord is not strong - it can only bear up to 10 lbs of weight, but it can be used, for example, to pull heavier rope across the same span.

Describe your tethered arrow.
